section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity (including drafting) before the budget gate has passed, or including budget-dependent content without a passing gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress with incomplete inputs.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe programme rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1-4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: Artifact schema_id is orch.tier5.excellence_section.v1 (an application-form section). Content references only 'Part B-1' and the 'Guide for Applicants'; no 'Annex N', 'Grant Agreement Annex', 'AGA Template' or 'Model Grant Agreement template' is used as a structural/schema authority. No violation.

Every call-requirement claim provides a Tier 2B reference.
check_notes.13.3: All project-fact claims (ELTE, MATE, MVCRI, AgroVIR, Prof. Jung, Dr. Hollos, Prof. Milics, Dr. Cholakova, deliverables, WP structure) carry Tier 3 source_refs (consortium/capabilities.json, call_binding/confirmation_checklist.json, project_brief/*, architecture_inputs/*). check_notes.13.4: This is a Phase 8 (orch.tier5.*) artifact. Content was scanned for budget figures (patterns '€N', 'N EUR', 'N person-months'); none are present — numeric references are timeline months (e.g. month 6/14/18/21/24/30), not budget values. The Excellence section carries no budget-dependent claims, so no budget-gate dependency is evidenced. Per the TAPM input boundary, the budget_gate_assessment.json was not read; the pass rests on the absence of budget-dependent content in the audited artifact, not on an assertion about gate state.

Programme/participation conditions referenced (non-academic placement provision, transferable-skills/open-science requirements, expected outcomes) are cited to Tier 2B call sources and the Tier 3 call_binding/confirmation_checklist, which is the appropriate tier for MSCA-PF call rules.
